test_title: PYST 42 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect narration of the following statement from the given alternatives:

The culprit said to the judge, "I am innocent as I did not commit the crime at all."

options.text: The culprit told the judge that he is innocent as I had not committed the crime at all.
The culprit told the judge that he was innocent as I did not commit the crime at all.
The culprit told the judge that he is innocent as I did not commit the crime at all.
The culprit told the judge that he was innocent as he had not committed the crime at all.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** The culprit said to the judge, "I am innocent as I did not commit the crime at all."
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Reporting verb "said to" becomes "told":** When an object (the judge) is mentioned, "said to" is changed to "told" in indirect speech.
 
• **Pronoun "I" becomes "he":** The first-person pronoun "I" changes according to the subject of the reporting verb (the culprit), becoming "he."
 
• **Tense Shift (Backshifting):**
 
 
• **"am" (Simple Present) becomes "was" (Simple Past):** Present state verbs shift to their past form.
 
• **"did not commit" (Simple Past) becomes "had not committed" (Past Perfect):** Past actions shift to the past perfect in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• The comma and quotation marks are removed and replaced with the conjunction **"that."**
 
• The sentence ends with a full stop.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The culprit told the judge that he was innocent as he had not committed the crime at all."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The culprit told the judge that he is innocent as I had not committed the crime at all."

 
 
• Incorrect tense ("is" should be "was") and incorrect pronoun ("I" should be "he").
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The culprit told the judge that he was innocent as I did not commit the crime at all."
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun ("I" should be "he") and incorrect tense ("did not commit" should be "had not committed").
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The culprit told the judge that he is innocent as I did not commit the crime at all."
 
 
• Failed to shift tenses ("is," "did not commit") and failed to change the second pronoun ("I").
